transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I feel like I’m on the verge of being a legendary visionary in fashion and everyone else is too small‑minded to keep up with me. My family and my job pressured me to come here, but they just don't see the big picture of what I'm trying to build.

Have you ever had a period of at least a week when you felt unusually depressed or lost interest in almost everything, separate from times like now? Or have your symptoms only ever been periods of feeling unusually energized, grand, or driven?

Yeah, I definitely have those crash periods that are totally separate from my high energy. I’ll just lie in bed for days staring at my shoes, feeling completely numb and dead inside. During those times, I lose interest in everything—I won't shower, answer texts, or even care if I lose my job.

During those crash periods, did they last at least 2 weeks and include symptoms like hopelessness, guilt, major sleep or appetite changes, or thoughts of death? Also, have you ever had a full manic episode like this one before, separate from those depressions?

Those low periods definitely last for a couple of weeks, but I don't really feel guilty or have thoughts of death—it's more of an extreme numbness where I have zero energy and just don't care about anything. As for having episodes like this before, I'm not really sure. Everything really started this past year after I got my promotion.

Before this current high-energy episode, have you ever had another separate time lasting at least a week when you were similarly unusually energized, needed much less sleep, felt especially powerful or grand, and got into trouble because of it? Or is this the first time anything like this has happened?

No, this definitely isn't the first time. These wired, high-energy phases where I barely sleep and chase sneaker ideas have been happening on and off for almost a year, ever since my promotion. Honestly, these amped-up periods take up most of my year, with only those short crashes in between.
